name: Hengerda New Materials (Fujian) Co., Ltd.
summary: Hengerda New Materials (Fujian) Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of industrial machine tools, metal cutting tools, and core machine elements of the equipment in China and internationally. It offers die cutting tools, including rule die steel and steel rules; sawing tools comprising bi-metal, carbide, band saw blades, and cermet circular saw blade; and intelligent equipment, such as high-speed band saw, circular saw, profile grinding machine, and machining centers, as well as linear guideways series products.
